title: Build an UNRELEASED 1.5.1 off the release line and hand the beta user a delta bundle to verify the slow-install fixes
description: MPI-717's three download fixes (MPI-716 telemetry, MPI-718 retry budget, MPI-719 scan race) can only be verified on the reporter's own machine: no link here sustains 20-40 KB/s and no harness can fake his disk. Port them onto the release line, stamp 1.5.1, BUILD but do NOT release - he applies the 1.5.0 -> 1.5.1 delta bundle offline with update-from-zip.bat, keeping his projects, models and engine, then sends back app.log. Procedure and every trap: tasks/<id>/brief.md. Cut the real release only after he confirms.
